name: requirements-workshop
description: A structured, multi-turn requirements discussion workflow with optional, explicitly requested PRD output for Codex conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify and confirm requirements through a focused chat workflow.
interface.longDescription: Runs a focused multi-turn product or task discovery conversation. It maintains a concise decision record, obtains final confirmation, and generates a structured PRD only when the user explicitly requests one.
defaultPrompt: Use Requirements Workshop to clarify this product idea.
Run a requirements discussion for this development task.
Confirm this feature scope, then generate a PRD.
